AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

Extent.title: Bill extent
Extent.description: Extent of data to be returned. E.g. it is possible to specify that together with the bills, payments and revenue items should be also returned.

ClosedUtc.title: Time interval
ClosedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` was closed.

IssuedUtc.title: Time interval
IssuedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` was issued.

PaidUtc.title: Time interval
PaidUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` was paid.

DueUtc.title: Time interval
DueUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` is due to be paid.

CreatedUtc.title: Time interval
CreatedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` was created.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Bill` was updated.

BillIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Bills`. Required if no other filter is provided.

State.description:
State the bills should be in. If not specified, `Open` and `Closed` bills are returned.

Open

Closed

Type.description:
Type of the bills. If not specified, all types are returned.

Receipt (Default; the bill has been paid in full; only applicable after the bill is closed.)

Invoice (Bill has not been paid in full but an invoice has been issued to request payment.)

CorrectionState.description: Whether to return regular bills, corrective bills, or both. If `BillIds` are specified, defaults to both, otherwise defaults to `Bill`.
